invariant: PlantUML applies skinparam dpi and explicit document scale once to the complete graphics backend, independently of SVG comments, processing instructions, declarations, element labels, or punctuation. Rust's finished-SVG scaling pass must therefore recognize non-element XML constructs by their own terminators and apply attribute quote tracking only inside actual opening or self-closing element tags.
causal_divergence: Rust scale_svg_numbers currently searches every '<' construct for the next unquoted '>' before deciding whether it is an element. The generated comment <!--class O'Brien Ledger--> contains an apostrophe, which opens a fictitious attribute quote. The scanner consequently copies the comment, entity group, rectangles, icon, and header text as one non-element span without scaling, then resumes inside the entity. Java's graphics-backend scale has no text-lexing dependency, so every primitive is uniformly scaled by dpi/96. The malformed classBorderColor command in the triggering input is unrelated: both implementations retain it and resolve its malformed color to white.
planned_change: Split finished-SVG lexical scanning by XML construct. Copy comments through '-->', processing instructions through '?>', CDATA through ']]>', declarations through their closing '>', and closing tags through '>'. Only opening and self-closing element tags use quote-aware '>' discovery and scale_tag. Preserve byte-oriented serialization and the existing numeric attribute/path/style transformations; do not parse or rewrite comment text.
perturbation_axes: apostrophes in class, package, link, and other generated XML comments versus no apostrophe
single, balanced, and repeated apostrophes inside non-element markup
skinparam dpi 96, 100, and 125 versus explicit scale directives
apostrophized entity first, middle, or last in the painted document
comments adjacent to processing instructions, declarations, CDATA, closing tags, and ordinary elements
valid, malformed, and absent legacy color skinparams with identical labels
scope_boundary: This mechanism owns lexical boundaries in the final SVG scaling pass. It does not change preprocessing, label parsing, style epochs, malformed-color fallback, entity dimensions, layout, XML comment contents, comparator behavior, or fixture eligibility.
acceptance: Every geometric element after an apostrophe-bearing XML comment is scaled uniformly by the active document factor.
Comments, processing instructions, declarations, CDATA, closing tags, and text content remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
Existing root rounding, path, polygon, style, font-size, filter, and oracle-layout scaling tests remain green.
Fresh Java-generated perturbations exercise at least two independent punctuation, scale, and entity-order axes through the no-oracle path.
An independent checker audits this account and implementation at exact revisions and preserves all passing or failing perturbations.
forbidden_approaches: special-casing O'Brien, class comments, fixture labels, or known SVG coordinates
removing or escaping generated comments solely to avoid the lexer defect
entity-specific rescaling or post-hoc geometry replacement
changing DPI values, style epochs, comparator tolerance, skip markers, or baselines

implementation_evidence.result: The generated comment, entity shell, icon, header, and member geometry now all receive the same document scale. The malformed legacy color remains white. The source still differs from Java only by a separately reproduced class-layout gap that is identical in the token-free control.
implementation_evidence.suite_evidence: 813/813 rustuml-render unit tests pass. The no-oracle product ratchet remains green at 11,170/11,250 with no family or baseline change.
